ratings_why.fun: Three payoff families share one Vote supply, and Dive, Almoner and Overflow each turn the water's downside into a tool, so every turn's Vote is a real call.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because it is a shared number both players write into, reshaping both boards by Health shape and turning the scouted next opponent into a Raise-or-Lower decision; no tribe today does either.

verdict_why: The core is right; Tiddy Mun's drowning rule reads two ways and Kees's targeting needs one line, so one more pass is worth it.

points.text: Tiddy Mun's text drowns once at Start of Combat, but the Drowning keyword says it keeps working all fight. Say on the card which it is.
Kees Kowk 'attacks an Under enemy if it can': say whether that reaches an Under unit in the back row while the front row stands.

Board Almoner wants units at or below your Level while Stretch-Holder lifts their Health by your Level. Lean into that tension: a slot-swap each turn between the two is a lovely puzzle, worth a build note.
Lower pays gold, stats and Overflow, while Raise pays mostly through reads. One small card that pays per Raise would make the Seesaw a two-sided pull rather than Drain with extra steps.
Keeper of the Overflow plus Penningmeester means each Lower is gold and water at once; a Drain board flooding with Tiddy Mun is the tribe's best combo and could be named as its own build.

standouts.why: Turns Lowers into fight water, so Drain and Flood share pieces; the kind of off-purpose bridge combo players hunt for.
Dive flips the water from a cost to a shelter, so you raise the water to sink your own coots on purpose.
Pays on every change either way, which makes flip-flopping votes a strategy and ties Pup, Sail-Setter, Bram and Hendrika together.

weakest.why: Generic lowest-Health buffer; it touches the water only by accident.
Just a bigger number on the water; no decision beyond 'play it in Flood'.
Plain gold per Lower; it adds pull toward Lower without adding a new interaction.

flags.note: Drowning keyword (all fight) and card text (Start of Combat) disagree.
With Gauge-Keeper and Overflow, continuous drowning at half the water could wipe wide boards; counterplay is tall units, a negative Level, or Motion Carried.
Targeting override vs the front-row rule is not stated.
With Sluiswacht and Hendrika, Lowers may pay 6+ gold a turn into uncapped carry-over.
